applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Payments Banks - Classification, Valuation, and Operation of Investment Portfolio) Second Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Payments banks must adopt the revised valuation methodology for quoted and unquoted units and instruments of InvITs and REITs.
answer.action_quote: Paragraph 83A shall be inserted as under: - “83A. Units of Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) ... Paragraph 83B shall be inserted as under: - “83B. Units of Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs)

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into effect from the date of issue.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Payments Banks - Classification, Valuation, and Operation of Investment Portfolio) Directions, 2025
